description: This PHP class 'DocParser' is a parser for docblock annotations, specifically a version adapted for Drupal that handles annotation parsing, metadata collection, and validation for Doctrine-style annotations.

classes.name: Drupal\Component\Annotation\Doctrine\DocParser
classes.description: A final class that parses docblock annotations, manages annotation metadata, and validates annotation usage within Drupal, based on Doctrine annotation standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DocParser with a new DocLexer instance.

methods.name: setIgnoredAnnotationNames
methods.description: Sets annotation names to ignore during parsing.

methods.name: setIgnoreNotImportedAnnotations
methods.description: Configures whether to ignore annotations that are not imported.

methods.name: addNamespace
methods.description: Adds a default namespace for annotation resolution, ensuring only one mode (namespaces or imports) is used.

methods.name: setImports
methods.description: Sets import mappings for annotation resolution, ensuring only one mode (namespaces or imports) is used.

methods.name: setTarget
methods.description: Sets the current target context for annotation parsing.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a docblock string for annotations, returning an array of annotation instances.

methods.name: findInitialTokenPosition
methods.description: Finds the position of the first valid annotation '@' in the docblock string.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches the next token with the expected token, throws syntax error if mismatch.

methods.name: matchAny
methods.description: Matches the next token with any of the provided tokens, throws syntax error if none match.

methods.name: syntaxError
methods.description: Generates a syntax error exception with a detailed message.

methods.name: classExists
methods.description: Checks if a class exists without autoload, using AnnotationRegistry if needed, with caching.

methods.name: collectAnnotationMetadata
methods.description: Collects and caches metadata for a specific annotation class, including properties, targets, and constructor info.

methods.name: collectAttributeTypeMetadata
methods.description: Analyzes attribute types and updates metadata accordingly, handling array types and internal type mappings.

methods.name: Annotations
methods.description: Parses multiple annotations from the docblock.

methods.name: Annotation
methods.description: Parses a single annotation, resolving its class, validating targets, and instantiating annotation objects with parameters.

methods.name: MethodCall
methods.description: Parses method call parameters within annotations.

methods.name: Values
methods.description: Parses a list of values or array entries within annotation parameters.

methods.name: Constant
methods.description: Resolves constants, including class constants and special identifiers like '::class'.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Parses an identifier or namespace-qualified name.

methods.name: PlainValue
methods.description: Parses a plain value, including literals, arrays, annotations, or constants.

methods.name: FieldAssignment
methods.description: Parses a field assignment within annotation parameters.

methods.name: ArrayX
methods.description: Parses an array literal within annotation parameters.

methods.name: ArrayEntry
methods.description: Parses an array entry, which can be a key-value pair or a value.

methods.name: identifierStartsWithBackslash
methods.description: Checks if an identifier starts with a backslash.

methods.name: identifierEndsWithClassConstant
methods.description: Checks if an identifier ends with '::class'.

methods.name: getClassConstantPositionInIdentifier
methods.description: Finds position of '::class' in an identifier.
